name: SmartArt
description: The top level class for interacting with a SmartArt graphic.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArt object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SmartArt object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: AllNodes
properties.description: Retrieves a SmartArtNodes object containing all of the nodes within the SmartArt diagram. Read-only.

properties.name: Nodes
properties.description: Retrieves the children of the root node of the SmartArt diagram. Read-only.

properties.name: Layout
properties.description: Retrieves or sets the SmartArt layout associated with the SmartArt graphic. Read/write.

properties.name: QuickStyle
properties.description: Retrieves or sets the SmartArt quick style applied to the SmartArt graphic. Read/write.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Retrieves or sets the SmartArt color style applied to the SmartArt graphic. Read/write.

properties.name: Reverse
properties.description: Gets or sets the state of the SmartArt diagram with LTR (left-to-right) or RTL (right-to-left), if the diagram supports reversal. Read/write.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the SmartArt graphic to its original state.
